$comment: Project-level Claude Code settings. Tracked in git on purpose: these are
the permissions a session needs to operate the hosted deployment, and a
fresh clone on a new machine should not have to rediscover them.
Everything here is either read-only or routed through Deploy/vm.sh and
Deploy/make-live.sh, both of which are in the repo and reviewable. The
genuinely irreversible steps are deliberately NOT allowlisted:
`Deploy/vm.sh authorize` grants a machine SSH access to production, and
